name: Mutsui Kaoruko
source:
Former Classmate with Enchanting Breasts: The Glamorous Teacher.

The newly appointed homeroom teacher for Class 1-2 at Saint Merhata Academy. She also serves as the overall commander for the academy's inter-school competition.

She is a classmate of the protagonist from their student days. Usually a dignified and serious teacher, she occasionally snaps at the protagonist as if transformed.

Having secretly harbored feelings for the protagonist during their student days, she now holds complex emotions regarding this inter-school competition.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/turibaka/]official site[/url]]
